newsitem.title: FALKLAND ISLANDS: British forces tackle Falklands tanker blaze.
newsitem.headline: British forces tackle Falklands tanker blaze.

text.p: British military tugs and firefighting crews were called in on Thursday to help tackle a fierce blaze on an oil tanker off the Falkland Islands, officials said.
The Panamanian-registered Baltic Prosperity, lying off Port Stanley, was carrying 2,300 tonnes of marine gas oil for distribution to fishing vessels in the Falklands area.
No casualties were reported among the 18-strong, mainly Latvian crew. The fire moved to the accommodation block after starting in the engine room.
The Falklands, in the South Atlantic, are known as the Malvinas by Argentina, which lost a brief war with Britain over the archipelago in 1982.
